category_edits.rationale: For all four datasets, blend 90% of the existing weighted pairwise loss with 10% uniform mean softplus loss over the same valid positions and sampled negatives. This encourages positive-negative separation while preserving the GRU, sampling, optimizer, schedule, and inference.

edits.replace:
weights = torch.softmax(valid_neg.detach(), dim=0)
    pairwise_loss = torch.nn.functional.softplus(valid_neg - valid_pos)
    existing_loss = (weights * pairwise_loss).sum()
    return 0.9 * existing_loss + 0.1 * pairwise_loss.mean()

change_summary: Apply the specified loss blend to every category’s single GRU model. No architecture or predictor changes are required.
